Taken (16 530 kWe edition): DS130PG/0525 (2025, newest PG data sheet): 'Output Power 16 530 kWe', 'Heat Rate 10 160 kJ/kWe-hr (9630 Btu/kWe-hr)', 'Exhaust Flow 202 510 kg/hr (446,460 lbs/hr)', 'Exhaust Temperature 490°C (910°F)', 'Engine efficiency: 35.4% (measured at generator terminals)', 'Industrial, Single-Shaft', '14 Stage Axial Compressor', 'Pressure Ratio: 19.1:1', 'Power Turbine - 3-Stage Reaction'. DS130GS/0221 (2021) prints the same four performance numbers and the package 14.2 x 3 x 3.9 m, 87 510 kg. BPGPH/0525 handbook: 16.5 MW, 10,160 kJ/kWe-hr, 'Electrical Efficiency % 35.4', 'Exhaust Gas Flow kg/s 56.3 / lb/s 124.0', 'Exhaust Gas Temp deg C 489 / deg F 912', fuel input 46.7 MJ/s. BIL/0622: 'Titan 130 16 530 35.4'. BO&G/0819: 'Titan 130 16 530'. eff_pct 35.4 is PUBLISHED (DS130PG/0525, DS130GS/0221 text, BPGPH/0525, BIL/0622); check 3600/10160 = 35.43 agrees. exh_flow_kg_s = 202 510 kg/hr / 3600 = 56.25 (unit conversion of the published hourly flow; the handbook publishes 56.3 kg/s directly). Older 15 000 kWe edition (DS130PG/0113, DS130GS/1109, BO&G/811, BIL/512, BPGPSG/116, Turbomach BPHBTBM/512): 15 000 kWe, 10 230 kJ/kWe-hr, 179 250 kg/hr (49.79 kg/s), 495 C, 35.2 %, PR 17.1:1 - an installed unit may still carry this rating; check the nameplate. Package: pkg_L/W/H/kg from DS130GS/0221 (complete set, dry, unenclosed height); height changed 3.7 -> 3.9 m (the earlier 3.7 m came from the BPGPH handbook table, which conflicts with both data sheets). Other editions differ widely (14.0-15.9 m long, 3.0-3.2 m wide, 3.1-3.9 m high, 77 100-94 395 kg) - see extra.pkg_other_editions; measure the installed package before design. No Turbomachinery Package Specification (TPS) for Titan 130 was found on www.manualsdir.com (site search 'titan 130', brand pages Cat/Caterpillar list only Taurus 70 and Titan 250 TPS), so systems data come from the data sheets. engine_kg/engine_L_m/engine_D_m set to null: the earlier 12 400 kg (6.1 x 2.6 x 2.1 m gas turbine module) came from a search extract of ASME paper 98-GT-590 (asmedigitalcollection.asme.org, host not open in this session) and is not printed in any opened document.
